notes: Cross-module bootstrap fix after 0.8.6.38 proved that a PRC eventhook registered in the previous module was not sufficient across StartNewModule. 0.8.6.39 adds xai_mod_boot and invokes it from global override scripts that PRC/BioWare resolves independently in every module: prc_ai_fam_percp, prc_pnp_fam_hide and evn_modgui. The bootstrap immediately forces PRC_PNP_SOMATIC_COMPOMENTS=0, PRC_PNP_SOMATIC_ITEMS=0 and PRC_SUMMON_ROUND_PER_LEVEL=0, then starts/restarts xai_init, xai_attach_all, xai_partycap, panel and reader for the current module. Existing Plada ordering from 0.8.6.38, reader 0.8.6.37, panel, Dorna logic, combat core 0.7.10.7 and familiar FIX5 remain preserved.
